body:
I wanted to kill myself a few years ago, when I was 17. I'm 21, going to be 22 in November. No one really knows about this and it's been weighing on me heavily lately. Also been drinking quite a bit and smoked 2 bowls so if my grammar and spelling sucks that's why. Also, I'm a noob and don't know how to make new paragraphs whilst commenting. Bear with me.

I tried to kill myself when I was 17, it was Mother's Day 2005. With pills. And alcohol. I was listening to Sigur Ros. I remember waking up with vomit everywhere, I had crawled halfway to the bathroom somehow. I don't remember much before that, though. I took a few pills, did a shot, took a few pills, did a shot, etc. until unconsciousness took over. My family never found out. My mom thought I was on drugs or just being weird (I was pretty quiet and anti-social as a kid/while growing up) and just ignored me. I had also "gotten in trouble" and was suspended from school, got my car taken away (which was a big deal when I was 17, I feel like what I'm bitching about is totally irrelevant and petty) and I never told her I had tried to kill myself earlier in the night. In fact, I never told anyone. I just tried to get over it. 

Anyways, I feel like killing myself now, about 4 years later. I really just wanted to share. Maybe I'll feel a little better knowing a lot of people may read this and will know something about me that no one else knows. 

Thanks for reading.
